title: Glass icon tumble relay over ribbon waves
summary: Three thick glass app tiles with white line glyphs tumble in one after another over a pastel iridescent ribbon field, settle centre, float, and hand over to the next. One locked shot, no copy: the material is the message.
use_when: Showing three features or app sections as icons, no UI needed
A premium, calm silent loop for a landing hero or social post
Opening an app announcement before the product UI appears
Brands with a light, glossy, glass-heavy visual language

look.type_style: no type; white rounded line glyphs (stroke ~8 % of tile width), extruded with visible thickness

sfx.event: last tile lifts out of the top edge

structure.shot: empty iridescent ribbon wave field; glass tile 1 (home-type glyph) rises edge-on from the bottom edge and tumbles to centre
structure.camera: locked-off; background unchanged 0.00 vs 12.27; motion.json 1.4 %/s zoom in s1 is the tile growing, not the camera
structure.motion: tile enters at 0.27 edge-on (yaw ~90 deg), rotates to face camera while rising from below frame to centre, scale ~0.5 to 1.0; springs.heavy ~36 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); faces camera by 1.50

structure.shot: tile 1 floats centre-left of frame, glass refracts the ribbons behind it
structure.motion: idle float: drift of a few px and ~1-2 deg tilt, easings.inOutSine (suggested, below sheet resolution); at 3.77 tile starts to shrink and lift up-right

structure.shot: tile 2 (globe glyph) swings in large from the left foreground while tile 1 recedes small up-right and leaves
structure.motion: tile 1 exit: scale 1.0 to ~0.5, moves up-right, gone by 4.50; tile 2: enters at 4.27 near edge-on and ~2x final size, yaw unwinds and scale 2.0 to 1.0 by 5.00, springs.heavy ~24-30 fr (±0.25 s)
small residual rotate-in 5.00 to 5.75, then idle float as row 2; recede begins at 7.77

structure.shot: tile 3 (tray glyph) slides in from the right, edge-on and large, knocking tile 2 away to the upper left
structure.motion: tile 2 exit: scale to ~0.6 and slide up-left, hidden behind tile 3 by 8.27; tile 3 enters at 8.00 from right edge yawed ~70 deg, unwinds with a roll of ~10 deg, scale ~1.3 to 1.0, faces camera by 9.25, springs.heavy ~36 fr (±0.25 s); motion.json pan -32 px/s in s9 = tile settling leftwards
idle float as row 2; from 11.00 starts drifting up

structure.shot: tile 3 lifts up out of the top edge; the empty wave field returns, matching frame 0
structure.motion: tile rises and shrinks, easings.inExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s); off frame by 12.27; empty field holds to the loop point

params.brand: brand.json: accent tints the ribbon gradient; glyph colour stays white
params.content.icons: 3 line glyph names (LineGlyph set or custom SVG paths), one per tile
params.timing.period: frames per tile (default ~120 at 30 fps: 4 s, entry ~36 fr, float, exit ~15 fr)
params.entries: per tile entry side and yaw: bottom / left foreground / right (default as reference)
params.loop: end on the empty field so the last frame matches frame 0 (default true)

notes: One shot, 0 cuts, silent. Each tile owns ~4 s; entries alternate direction (bottom, left foreground, right). Sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Spring choices, float amplitude and exit easing are suggestions: the 4 fps sheets cannot show overshoot. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): glass-icon-tile (thick glass app tile with extruded white glyph), ribbon-wave-field (static iridescent 3D ribbon background), tile-relay (next object enters as the previous exits). physics tag = rigid-body tumble and the push-out at 8.00-8.27, not a measured simulation.
